rule_results.explanation: Entry Foyer located in neutral Center zone (ideal is North / East / Northeast).
Living Room located in neutral South zone (ideal is North / East / Northeast).
Kitchen located in neutral Center zone (ideal is Southeast).
Dining Room placed in auspicious West zone. Dining in West or East promotes nourishment and wholesome communal dining.
Common Bathroom placed in auspicious Northwest zone. Wet zones and drainage in West/Northwest keep toxins away from the sacred Northeast (Ishanya) and center.
Staircase Core placed in acceptable Northwest zone (ideal is South / West / Southwest).
Circulation Hall placed in auspicious Northwest zone. Secondary bedrooms are well positioned in South, West or Northwest sectors.
Master Suite located in unadvisable Northeast zone (conflicts with Vastu principles: Southwest preferred).
Bedroom 2 located in neutral Center zone (ideal is Southwest).
Master En-suite located in neutral North zone (ideal is West / Northwest).

Balcony / Terrace located in neutral East zone (ideal is South / West / Northwest).

Structural system assumption: RCC Frame with 6.0 in solid slab.
Column count: 22 columns positioned along structural walls and envelope.
Preliminary beam count: 26 beams connecting column grid nodes.
Clearance verified: Zero column obstruction of door openings, stairs, and parking.
Multi-floor alignment: Columns stack continuously from ground to top floor.

column_alignment_issues: [INFO] Continuous Vertical Grid: All 22 columns stack vertically through Ground + 1 upper floor(s).
[REVIEW] Master Suite on Floor 2 extends beyond ground floor column bay. Review vertical alignment and slab projection.
validation_report.summary: Preliminary structural checks verified 22 column positions and 26 preliminary beams. All spatial clearances satisfied.

structural_zones.recommendation: Four perimeter columns with tied tie-beams around stair opening.

slab_assumptions.span_assumption: Maximum clear span recommended <= 16 ft without intermediate beam.

structural_planning.disclaimer: Preliminary structural planning only. Final column sizes, beam sizes, reinforcement, foundations and structural safety must be designed and verified by a qualified structural-engineer.

feature_summary: Topology concept: Linear circulation corridor along one flank provides natural cross-ventilation and uninterrupted garden views.

The circulation hall is positioned along a side.
Solver-produced shared-wall relationships: entry foyer–living room, entry foyer–kitchen, dining–entry foyer, entry foyer–staircase, entry foyer–hallway, kitchen–living room.
